description: Emmerson Lab Launch Initiative (ELLI): Cyclic Loading of a Three-Story Building with Lateral Force Resisting Systems (LFRS) using Mass Timber Products and Steel Energy Dissipators is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Arijit Sinha, Oregon State University (oregonstate.edu). This project tests innovative lateral force resisting systems (LFRSs) comprised of newer mass timber products and steel energy dissipation mechanisms. These LFRSs represent a suite of resilient design techniques that can localize damage in special hardware designed to dissipate energy during an earthquake or similar disturbance. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: quasi-static, cyclic loading, MPP, VLT, mass timber, BRB. Published 2024-12-16. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
